title: The Hottest Air Ever Recorded Hit 134 Degrees

scenes.text: The hottest air ever measured on Earth was 134 degrees Fahrenheit.
It happened in Death Valley on July tenth, 1913.
That week the temperature topped 127 degrees every single day, and three days passed 130.
It never even cooled below 85 degrees at night.
For years Libya held the record, until experts found an observer error.
So the world's hottest day is still in Death Valley.

description:
The hottest air temperature ever officially recorded was 134 degrees Fahrenheit in Death Valley on July 10, 1913.
The heat wave stayed above 127 degrees every day for a week, and experts rejected Libya's older claim in 2012.
Could you survive a day there?
first_comment: The 2023 park high was 128 degrees. How hot is your hottest day?
